scope: Recover the fixed 39-layer student only; do not change depth, shapes, tokenizer, MTP exclusion, or W4A16 group-32 serving format.

training_contract.runtime: single 80GB H100 or H200 with CUDA BF16, FlashAttention2, PyTorch/Transformers/PEFT versions recorded with image digest before launch

lora.base_weights: frozen BF16 student materialized from the exact source-bound mapping

training_contract.loss: mean KL(teacher next-token top-64 logits || student logits) + 0.25 * mean MSE at the eight student-pre-skip/teacher-post-skip hidden bridges

data_and_contamination_contract.permitted_training_source: HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu, exact revision and selected document-id SHA-256 manifest captured before teacher inference
data_and_contamination_contract.selection: deterministic first clean 4M tokenizer tokens after document-id hashing; remove documents that exactly match any frozen development prompt/content hash
data_and_contamination_contract.teacher_cache: top-64 logits (token ids and BF16 logit values) plus eight BF16 2048-wide bridge states; shard hashes and tokenizer revision required
data_and_contamination_contract.reason: Teacher capture is a separate sequential stage, so the 58.15 GiB teacher and 46.31 GiB student never co-reside.

stages.name: source_and_runtime_admission
stages.pass: preflight mapping SHA-256 e501ab11290cd38424fd5ed93f9e9fd55145a7ed98cb6acddcc21b4122accb3a; 80GB GPU; pinned image digest; source/data manifests

stages.name: teacher_capture
stages.pass: all cache shards hash, every sequence has top-64 logits and eight bridge tensors
stages.fail: stop; do not train against partial cache

stages.name: lora_recovery
stages.pass: finite loss; held-back non-evaluation cache KL improves by >=5% versus step 0 at 1M tokens and does not regress by >2% at 4M
stages.fail: stop and retain only the best deterministic adapter

stages.name: merge_and_awq
stages.pass: merged 39-layer BF16 checkpoint and compressed-tensors symmetric W4 group-32 conversion preserve tokenizer, final norm/head, and no-MTP identity

stages.name: development_gate
stages.pass: at least 5/6 in every frozen category, valid runtime input-logprob artifacts where ceilings exist, no malformed/truncated result, deterministic checkpoint identity
stages.fail: stop; recovery is not quality eligible

memory_envelope.excluded: L40S 48GB; it cannot admit the BF16 base with reliable activation and allocator headroom.

economics.assumption: The cap includes one sequential teacher capture, LoRA pass, conversion, and bounded development gate; it is an envelope, not a performance claim.

quality_claim: none until the final frozen-development gate passes
